correctness.rationale: The exact identity a_(N-1)=sum_(k>=0)(2k-1)!! C(N,2k+1) yields a_(N-1)/N=sum c_k C(N-1,2k), c_k=(2k-1)!!/(2k+1). For 27|N the only nonintegral c_k are k=1,4, and the two binomial coefficients are 1 mod9; their combination (1+35)/3=12 is zero mod3. All other k>=2 terms have v3>=1 by finite base bound and exponential tail estimate. So a_(N-1)/N is a 3-adic unit. The established involution periodicity mod3^r and full vector of a_0..a_26 mod27 now reduce all n to three exceptional n mod9 classes: 4 -> valuation2, 6 -> valuation1, 8 -> v3(n+1), others zero. Independent integer recurrence mod729 confirmed 4000 indices; this is corroboration, not a proof of infinite period.
